reasoning: As of March 6, 2026, evidence shows Russia has not formally joined the Board of Peace despite receiving invitations. Key facts: (1) Russia declined to attend the February 19, 2026 founding meeting; (2) As of mid-February, Russian officials stated Russia was still deliberating without urgency; (3) Trump claimed Putin 'accepted' on January 22, but this was not formally confirmed by Russia; (4) Putin proposed using frozen assets for membership fees, but Trump never responded; (5) Ukrainian opposition and Western criticism created diplomatic obstacles; (6) Russian officials emphasized careful deliberation with no rush to decide. With only ~25 days remaining until March 31, and Russia showing no signs of imminent formal membership despite months of consideration, formal admission appears unlikely.
